item.title: Baqaei: Broken US promises, not Iranians’ religious beliefs, obstruct negotiations

item.title: IRGC Navy says four oil-carrying ships hit in Persian Gulf
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Navy has said four ships were hit and caught fire while transferring oil cargoes in the northern Persian Gulf, adding that three other vessels had suffered incidents after striking mines west of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran urges UNSC to condemn US maritime blockade, calls for its immediate removal

item.title: Iran and Iraq aim to increase tourist exchanges to 10 million, minister says
item.description: Ahvaz, IRNA – Iran and Iraq have the potential to increase annual tourist exchanges to 10 million people, Tourism Minister Reza Salehi-Amiri said on Wednesday, stressing the need for new planning and stronger cross-border infrastructure to achieve the target.
